use_case_summary: Customer support chat agents for a B2B SaaS. Live chat + escalation to human. Agent flows include: context-aware responses (past convo memory), tool calling to create tickets and fetch account metadata, and streaming partial responses to UI. Target SLO: first-token <1.5s 95th percentile, end-to-end resolution latency under interactive thresholds. Peak concurrency ~250, steady-state 80-120 active chats. Must support structured JSON outputs for downstream routing.
requirements_details:
- Streaming with partial tokens to render first-byte quickly (UI UX requirement).
- Function/Tool calling to post tickets (secure webhook sandbox).
- Model preferences: want smaller low-latency model for first-pass + larger fallback for complex queries.
- Routing: geo-aware routing (NA/EU) and fallback policy when capacity constrained.
- Observability: token-level latency & cost breakdown, per-route dashboards, alerting on first-token regressions.
- Compliance: SOC2, SSO/SAML, audit logs retention 2 years, EU data residency for subset of customers.
- Cost target: hosted POC must show per-conversation cost < $0.10 at steady state; committed Dedicated should target 40% lower unit cost.
- Timeline: 2-week POC -> evaluation phase (3-4 weeks) -> procurement decision by 2026-04 if satisfied.
